remaining_priorities: Preserve assertion predicates, objects and can/must modal strength within selected spans; extra or stronger claims must not publish.
Project source scope rules plus request-only subjects into independently reviewed question conclusions (Cloudflare); do not require official source to repeat user domain names.
Deduplicate and budget complete question core/exception originals before Writer; a pure clarification must not clear real omitted-source gaps.
Separate valid local clarification/insufficient answers from dimension-global comparison status in Reflector; retain genuine source and binding blockers.
Recover Dropbox official bodies or report a clear failed-source state; do not treat zero-source empty output as successful refusal.
limitations: Known exposed questions; no claim of general accuracy, controlled improvement or token efficiency.
Question correctness and all-published-claim binding are separate measures; 0 question errors does not mean 0 defective assertions.
Two correct insufficient-price responses are not verified amount positives.
Finite EN/ZH action and clarification recognizers do not prove universal NLI or compound-question parsing.
Fresh independent review is Agent judgment, not new human acceptance.
Secret scans exclude actual environment bodies and Git history; final receipt records their scope and results.

secret_scan.scope: nonignored working-tree text, built frontend and current new artifacts; excludes actual environment bodies and Git history
